description: This script analyzes JavaScript source code to detect usage of specific function calls related to reading request bodies, particularly in webhook handlers. It sets up rules and utility functions to parse and process source files, focusing on security-sensitive operations within a project, especially related to webhook authentication and request processing.

methods.name: findBlockedWebhookBodyReadLines
methods.description: Function that parses the source content and returns line numbers where specified blocked functions are called.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main async function that initiates the callsite guard with configuration to detect forbidden body read calls.

methods.name: getCalleeName
methods.description: Utility function to extract the callee function name from an expression.
